name: Roomote (Roo Code)
summary: Cloud coding agent from the creators of Roo Code that ships pull requests, hosted or self-hosted.
description: Roomote is a cloud coding agent built by the team behind the open-source Roo Code extension; roocode.com now redirects to it. It runs in the project's real development environment, verifies its own work, reviews code with a different model and opens pull requests for human review. It can be hosted by the company or self-hosted.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The official site says self-hosting is free for up to 10 users. Roomote Cloud starts at $49/month after a 7-day trial.
